items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My father had given me four cows when I graduated from grammar school.

ctx.x: What were your parents reactions to you going away to college? Was this something they encouraged?

I didn’t want to go. My father had given me four cows when I graduated from grammar school. He kept those cows in his herd, but kept books on how they reproduced and what I owned. I thought I was going to be a cattleman.
So by then these four cows had multiplied into quite a herd of your own.
